messages:
niko: Quick update  NimbusHarbor interview finished. Recording + raw transcript in Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/nimbusharbor/interview. Need: public quote, short hero clip, webinar stat slide, captions (EN/CN), embargo timing, and lead routing.

anya: Awesome. They used a line like "we saw latency drop dramatically" and mentioned specific p95 numbers. Legal will want that softened.

matt: For webinar deck product wants a single safe stat we can put on the hero slide. Ops: can we add tracking + route demo requests to Liz?

legal-bot: Checklist: NDA present; release form pending. Public copy should avoid raw p-values and request IDs. Recommended public phrasing: "reduced inference latency and cost (e.g., ~50% cost reduction)". If customer wants exact telemetry publicly, require signed telemetry addendum.

niko: Thanks. I'll draft two public-safe quote options (one tight, one looser) and send to NimbusHarbor for 48h sign-off.

anya: Also need a 30s hero clip for social + 3x 20s webinar soundbites. I can cut EN/CN captions after clips are up. Can we get clips by EOD today? :clock4:

matt: I can get the clips up today. Where should I upload?

niko: Use the same Drive folder and name assets: hero_30s.mp4, webinar_20s_1.mp4, etc. Link will be in the draft landing page.

ops-bot: Routing rule request received. Proposed tags: utm_campaign=nimbusharbor_launch, source=social, lead_tag=benchmark-inbound. Rule: if lead has lead_tag=benchmark-inbound -> assign to AE Liz (liz@redwood.ai) and set priority = high-touch.

matt: Adding UTMs to the landing link. Example: 
```
https://redwood.ai/nimbus?utm_campaign=nimbusharbor_launch&utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=social
```
Will drop pixel and test flow.

legal-bot: Please attach the signed release form and the redlined transcript before legal finalizes. Provisional approval pending those items.

niko: Drafted two options and sending to the customer now: 1) "Redwood reduced our inference costs by ~50% and improved response times." 2) "We saw meaningful latency and cost improvements after switching to Redwood." Which would you recommend?

anya: Send both. Ask them to confirm the public-safe option. If they push exact numbers, note the telemetry addendum requirement.

matt: Clips uploaded: https://drive.redwood.ai/nimbusharbor/assets (hero_30s.mp4, webinar_20s_1.mp4, webinar_20s_2.mp4, webinar_20s_3.mp4). EN captions included; CN captions pending vendor.

ops-bot: Pixel added and HubSpot flow created. Routing test successful; demo assignment to Liz OK.

niko: Customer replied: they approve option 1 (the ~50% wording) and signed the release. Uploading signed PDF now.

legal-bot: Received signed release. Please attach the redlined transcript to the release form for legal review.

niko: Redlined transcript uploaded. 

legal-bot: Final legal review complete  all checks green. Embargo permitted.

anya: Embargo set to 2026-04-20 08:00 PT. Ops - schedule landing + social at that time and include webinar CTA linking to 2026-05-04 deep-dive.

ops-bot: Scheduled landing publish and social queue for 2026-04-20 08:00 PT. Webinar CTA points to registration page: https://events.redwood.ai/nimbus-deepdive. HubSpot tags and pixel live.

ae-liz: I'll prep follow-up email template for demo outreach and stand by for hot-lead alerts at launch.

niko: Thanks team  quick follow-ups: confirm CN captions vendor choice (Ops recommended TranscribeNow for speed), and Marie will localize copy after legal-approved wording.

ops-bot: TranscribeNow selected for CN captions (ETA 48h). Will notify when captions ready.

anya: All assets ready and linked. Will hand off to comms for scheduling once legal flips final green. :rocket:
